# Knowledge index

Rewritten: <YYYY-MM-DD>

## Files

<!-- One line per file or folder: path relative to knowledge/, what it holds, when to read it. -->

- `glossary.md`: canonical terms, their aliases and the source of each meaning. Read when a word in a ticket, thread or diff is unclear.
- `flows/`: one business flow per file, from entry point to side effects, with anchors. Read the flow a task touches before planning it.
- `decisions.md`: repo-level decisions with the alternatives rejected. Read before proposing something that may already have been decided.
- `questions.md`: questions to the team, the answer and the decision each one unblocked. Read before asking the team again.
- `library/`: dated stories (PRs reviewed, explanations, investigations, superseded rules). Never loaded by default; search it with grep.
- `review/rules.md`: the rules the team applies in review. Read by every reviewer.
- `review/false-positives.md`: findings discarded with the protection that makes them safe. Read by every reviewer before reporting.
- `inbox/`: staged items waiting for the human to route them. Read only when routing.
- `architecture/`: one file per repo with layers, placement, invariants and deviations. Read before planning, implementing or reviewing in that repo.
- `patterns/`: one folder per repo, one file per capability, with the exemplar to imitate. Read the capability a change touches.

## Repos

<!-- One line per adopted repo. -->

- <repo>: `architecture/<repo>.md`, `patterns/<repo>/`
